2609.04180.title: Knowledge Acquisition During Pre-training? Large Language Models Learn Better With Auxiliary Views
2609.04180.paper_summary: Gaps remain in our understanding of how large language models (LLMs) acquire knowledge during pre-training. We posit that auxiliary views, reformulations of knowledge, are causally helpful for learning. We design controlled experiments to isolate this. First, we confirm that repetition is necessary for acquisition and clarify that paraphrasing helps only at smaller batch sizes. Second, holding the token budget fixed, allocating tokens from document repetition to auxiliary views improves learning, counterintuitively, even for factual recall. Third, the effectiveness of auxiliary views is not contingent on the strength of the teacher model that generates them. Fourth, we identify forms of knowledge, contextual and foundational, that aid learning in the presence of prior knowledge gaps. Finally, we examine how these effects manifest mechanistically via layer-wise biases and compression. Together, our findings suggest that auxiliary representations of knowledge, which arise naturally in large pre-training corpora, are a key factor in the success of pre-training and offer a plausible explanation for why data diversity matters.
2609.04180.paper_summary_zh: 在我們對大型語言模型（LLMs）在預訓練期間如何獲取知識的理解中仍然存在空白。我們假設輔助視角，即知識的重述，對學習有因果上的幫助。我們設計了控制實驗來隔離這一點。首先，我們確認重複對於獲取是必要的，並澄清重述僅在較小的批次大小中有幫助。其次，在固定的標記預算下，將來自文檔重複的標記分配給輔助視角，反而會改善學習，即使在事實回憶方面也是如此，這看似違反直覺。第三，輔助視角的有效性並不依賴於生成它們的教師模型的強度。第四，我們識別出幾種知識形式，包括上下文知識和基礎知識，有助於在存在先前知識空白的情況下進行學習。最後，我們檢查這些效果如何通過層級偏差和壓縮在機械上表現出來。綜合來看，我們的發現表明，知識的輔助表徵，這些表徵在大型預訓練語料庫中自然出現，是預訓練成功的關鍵因素，並提供了一個合理的解釋，說明為什麼數據多樣性是重要的。
